name: Synthetic demo regions, protein channels
note: Marker channels of the SYNTHETIC demo multiplex image (examples/make_demo.py). Each type is named after the drawn region whose channel it lists, so tests/smoke_test.py can check the suggested names of the grid layer's clusters. Synth-Autofluor is left out on purpose: it is smooth tissue-wide background, not a marker of one region. Not a biological panel.
